result.summary: I found 1 potential layout issue: some content at the bottom is clipped by the fixed navigation bar, making the next restaurant card partially hidden.

issues.description: The restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so part of the content is not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content or reduce the overlay effect of the bottom nav so cards are fully visible above it.
